reviewer: Codex publication_audit; rights and decoded-method subreview by rights_inventory
scope: Bounded independent read-only verification of the actual P1 manifest, preserved full primary/decoded scan receipts, existing candidate classifications, rights delta and clean public ancestry. Not a complete V1, legal eligibility, human/hearing, performance, remote push or CI signoff.

final_manifest.self_hash_exception: Explicitly documented to avoid a content-hash cycle; containing P1 Git commit identifies the manifest bytes

source_equivalence.test_selection: tests/ .ts/.tsx/.mjs/.mts/.js/.json excluding historical native-accessibility-evidence payloads, same predicate as the frozen P0 review
source_equivalence.comparison: Fixed-ref Git blob identity and file mode against integrated source 14da; no product/test edits hidden by metadata changes

candidate_independent_verification.method: Match every primary hit and root classified hit to the original reviewed candidate by immutable Git blob SHA, rule, byte offset and candidate SHA-256; then read each actual public Git blob and recompute captured-value hash and length at that offset
candidate_independent_verification.literal_value_definition: Regex group 1, not the whole assignment match
candidate_independent_verification.url_value_definition: Whole URL-userinfo rule match, consistent with the original rule

rights_delta.delta: P1 additions are text/JSON validation receipts, handwritten decoded-scanner source and completion metadata; no dependency, product source, third-party license, SDK binary or material additions
rights_delta.omitted_raw_bundle_pcm_and_original_hist: Remain local-only; archive metadata does not claim public downloading or full reproduction
rights_delta.root_license: No license selected or substituted by this reviewer

validation_evidence_read.scope: Actual P0 fresh-public validation receipts were read; P1 production, test-source and schema bytes remain identical. No independent test rerun, no new human/hearing/long-run performance assertion.

limits: Rule-based scan receipts plus independent candidate/rights review support publication of this exact source ref, not proof that every conceivable secret representation is absent.

Decoded scanning recognizes UTF-16 BOM, serialized JSON and whitespace-free base64 JSON strings of at least 80 characters with length divisible by four; depth64 and 10MiB decoded bounds apply. Non-JSON base64 is opaque only when its property is named body. Arbitrary encoded or encrypted data is not comprehensively covered.

Decoded rules have no independent generic Authorization: Bearer-header signature; detection uses provider tokens, JWTs and literal assignments. Primary plain-text rules and their candidate classifications are a separate part of this review.
Minimal process receipts do not record the tool SHA at execution. The hashes above identify reviewed P1 tool source, not independent cryptographic execution attestation.

Preserved raw receipts currently reside in the explicitly authorized local validation cache. Their existence does not make them downloadable from a public clone unless separately included in a later reviewed commit.

Any P2 completion metadata or other later public ref must rebuild its exact manifest and receive the required final scan or scoped delta verification; this P1 review does not preapprove future commits.
R18 user FPS failure and R17 negative performance remain. Source publication is not complete product acceptance or legal/root-license approval.
